name: TAF Inpatient Claims Occurrence Codes File
description: The TAF Inpatient Claims Occurrence Codes file contains occurrence code records associated with inpatient hospital claims submitted to Medicaid. Each record represents one occurrence code entry on a claim and includes the occurrence code and associated date, capturing events relevant to the hospitalization such as accident dates, onset of symptoms, or Medicare benefit exhaustion.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Claims Occurrence Codes
description: Occurrence code records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) Inpatient Claims. Each row represents a single occurrence code entry associated with an inpatient facility claim. Occurrence codes are UB-04 standardized codes that indicate specific events during or related to the hospitalization.

content.clm_id: String: Unique claim identifier linking to the IP Header record
content.msis_ident_num: String: Medicaid system identifier number assigned by the state
content.year: Int32: Reference year of the claim
content.occ_num: Int32: Sequential occurrence code number within the claim (1-based index)
content.ocrnc_cd: String: Occurrence code (UB-04 form locator 31-34) indicating a specific event or condition related to the claim
content.ocrnc_efctv_dt: Date32[day]: Date associated with the occurrence code event (e.g., accident date, symptom onset date, Medicare benefit exhaustion date)
